title: Tool Grinders, Filers, and Sharpeners
description: Perform precision smoothing, sharpening, polishing, or grinding of metal objects.

tasks.text: Monitor machine operations to determine whether adjustments are necessary, stopping machines when problems occur.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Malfunction detection relies on live physical observation

dwas.name: Watch operating equipment to detect malfunctions.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Select and mount grinding wheels on machines, according to specifications, using hand tools and applying knowledge of abrasives and grinding procedures.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Select production equipment according to product specifications.
Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Set up and operate grinding or polishing machines to grind metal workpieces, such as dies, parts, and tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Inspect, feel, and measure workpieces to ensure that surfaces and dimensions meet specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Inspect finishes of workpieces or finished products.
Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Perform basic maintenance, such as cleaning and lubricating machine parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical production equipment maintenance

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.
Maintain production or processing equipment.
Lubricate production equipment.

tasks.text: Remove finished workpieces from machines and place them in boxes or on racks, setting aside pieces that are defective.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically packaging products for shipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.
Package products for storage or shipment.

tasks.text: Study blueprints or layouts of metal workpieces to determine grinding procedures, and to plan machine setups and operational sequences.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Blueprint setup reading partial, human confirms

dwas.name: Study blueprints or other instructions to determine equipment setup requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Dress grinding wheels, according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying solutions to equipment is manual

dwas.name: Apply solutions to production equipment.

tasks.text: Remove and replace worn or broken machine parts, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal and fitting of worn components

dwas.name: Remove accessories, tools, or other parts from equipment.
Replace worn equipment components.

tasks.text: Fit parts together in pre-assembly to ensure that dimensions are accurate.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Machine tool assembly is skilled manual work

dwas.name: Assemble machine tools, parts, or fixtures.

tasks.text: File or finish surfaces of workpieces, using prescribed hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hand finishing of metal edges with tools

dwas.name: Smooth metal surfaces or edges.

tasks.text: Inspect dies to detect defects, assess wear, and verify specifications, using micrometers, steel gauge pins, and loupes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Compute numbers, widths, and angles of cutting tools, micrometers, scales, and gauges, and adjust tools to produce specified cuts.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Production requirement calc; human validates inputs

dwas.name: Calculate specific material, equipment, or labor requirements for production.
Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.

tasks.text: Turn valves to direct flow of coolant against cutting wheels and workpieces during grinding.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical valve/control manipulation for coolant

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate coolant flow.

tasks.text: Attach workpieces to grinding machines and form specified sections and repair cracks, using welding or brazing equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.
Operate welding equipment.

tasks.text: Straighten workpieces and remove dents, using straightening presses and hammers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hammering metal is physical hand work

dwas.name: Shape metal workpieces with hammers or other small hand tools.

tasks.text: Place workpieces in electroplating solutions or apply pigments to surfaces of workpieces to highlight ridges and grooves.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying finishes requires hands-on coating work

dwas.name: Immerse objects or workpieces in cleaning or coating solutions.
Apply protective or decorative finishes to workpieces or products.

tasks.text: Duplicate workpiece contours, using tracer attachments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drawing guide lines on materials is hands-on

dwas.name: Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.
